tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground on every marketing page. Warm off-white so the white product frames sit visibly on top of it.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, pricing plans, FAQ panels, the phone body. One step above paper.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Alternate section bands (logos strip, 'How it works') and secondary button hover.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunken. Same zinc-900 as the product.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Ledes, supporting copy, captions on any paper token.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Mono meta lines: timestamps, eyebrows, 'last verified' dates, on any paper token. Never for sentences.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between sections, turns in a thread and FAQ rows. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that must be found: input underlines, the upload drop zone, the phone body outline. Meets 3:1 on paper.

tokens.name: nudge
tokens.usage: THE accent. Primary button fill, focus ring, progress fill, the wordmark square. One job per view; never a background band.

tokens.name: nudge-deep
tokens.usage: Link text and primary hover, on paper, paper-raised and nudge-wash.

tokens.name: nudge-wash
tokens.usage: Tint behind a recommended plan or a selected state. Put nudge-deep text on it, not nudge.

tokens.name: on-nudge
tokens.usage: Label text on a nudge fill (primary button).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The highlighter: marks the value the agent pulled out of a casual reply ('rev was 145k'). Ink text on it. Only ever on extracted values, never for emphasis in headlines.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The one dark band per page: the closing CTA. on-night text on it.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Headline and body text on night.

tokens.name: on-night-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting text on night.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset on every interactive element. Alias of nudge; meets 3:1 on every paper token in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Proof visuals only: 'fulfilled', 'complete', 'live'. As text on success-wash. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: success-wash
tokens.usage: Badge ground behind success text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Proof visuals only: 'needs a person', 'waiting on you'. As text on warning-wash. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: warning-wash
tokens.usage: Badge ground behind warning text.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Proof visuals only: 'stalled', upload errors. As text on destructive-wash. Darkened from the product's #dc2626, which is 3.9:1 on its wash.

tokens.name: destructive-wash
tokens.usage: Badge ground behind destructive text.

tokens.name: product-surface
tokens.usage: Inside ProductFrame and PhoneFrame only. The product has no dark mode, so product UI renders light in both themes.

tokens.name: product-sidebar
tokens.usage: Dashboard sidebar, table headers and side rails inside ProductFrame.

tokens.name: product-ink
tokens.usage: Text inside product mockups, on product-surface and product-sidebar.

tokens.name: product-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text inside product mockups.

tokens.name: product-border
tokens.usage: Card borders and header rules inside product mockups.

tokens.name: product-chip
tokens.usage: Chips, inbound message bubbles, row dividers inside product mockups.

tokens.name: product-primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active nav and progress inside dashboard mockups. Fixed: does not lighten in dark theme like nudge does.

tokens.name: product-accent
tokens.usage: Active nav background and outbound bubbles inside dashboard mockups.

tokens.name: product-warning
tokens.usage: 'waiting on you' / 'needs a person' badge text inside mockups, on product-warning-wash.

tokens.name: product-warning-wash
tokens.usage: Badge ground behind product-warning inside mockups.

tokens.name: product-success
tokens.usage: 'complete' / 'fulfilled' badge text and done ticks inside mockups, on product-success-wash.

tokens.name: product-success-wash
tokens.usage: Badge ground behind product-success inside mockups.

tokens.name: operator-teal
tokens.usage: Accent of the fictional operator 'Riverside Mortgages' in white-labelled client mockups. White text on it passes.

tokens.name: operator-berry
tokens.usage: Accent of the fictional operator 'Altogether Ventures' in white-labelled client mockups. White text on it passes.

tokens.name: operator-wash
tokens.usage: Soft tint behind operator-teal content (reassurance notes) in client mockups.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline, one per page. 44px / 48px below 720px wide.

styles.name: display-l
styles.sample: Your next client won't have to be chased.
styles.usage: Closing CTA headline and page titles on secondary pages. 36px / 42px on mobile.

styles.name: display-m
styles.sample: Every open request is a business you're not closing.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Step titles, card titles, plan names.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Step numbers and big plain figures (prices). Serif numerals as a shape, not a stat.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: renudge.it follows up by email, text and chat until your clients send what you need.
styles.usage: Subheadline under a display headline. Max 60ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: It's not that clients don't want to help. They get busy, they get confused, they forget.

styles.name: body-s
styles.sample: Reminders and follow-ups are never charged extra.
styles.usage: Card copy, FAQ answers, captions under product visuals.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Reassurance lines under CTAs, footnotes. Never below 13px on marketing pages.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section eyebrows and sender labels, uppercase. Reads like a message header.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Timestamps, channels, file types, URLs, 'last verified' dates.

styles.name: product-title
styles.usage: Page titles inside ProductFrame. Copied from the dashboard spec.

styles.name: product-label
styles.usage: Table column labels inside ProductFrame, uppercase.

styles.name: client-h1
styles.sample: Hi Alan — Altogether Ventures needs ten things from you

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Chip padding, icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a button's label and arrow; between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; gap between eyebrow and headline.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; desktop gutter; headline to lede.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Lede to CTA row; between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between a section's text block and its product visual.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Mobile section padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Desktop section padding (top and bottom).

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Hero top padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs. Same 0.375rem as the product.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, pricing plans, ProductFrame. Same 0.625rem as the product.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Client cards and the phone screen. Same 1rem as the product's client pages.

tokens.name: radius-device
tokens.usage: PhoneFrame body only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips and status badges. Never buttons on marketing pages.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: Pricing plans and client task cards. Same as the product's raised client card.

tokens.name: shadow-frame
tokens.usage: ProductFrame and PhoneFrame: the only deep shadow on the site, so the product reads as the object on the page.

tokens.name: width-page
tokens.usage: Max content width. Matches the Requests screen container.

tokens.name: width-prose
tokens.usage: Max width for running copy, legal pages and template checklists.

tokens.name: width-hero-text
tokens.usage: Max width of the hero headline block.
